what: After .2s of hovering on a card, the image tilts away from the cursor: ratio from center × 13° on the Y axis and 15° on the X axis, also shifting 20px and 15px (perspective 800px). Following is a .4s exponential interpolation, so it settles smoothly when the cursor stops, and returns to 0 on leave.

options.ry: Max tilt on Y axis (deg), default 13
options.rx: Max tilt on X axis (deg), default 15
options.delay: Seconds after entering before the cursor starts reading, default .2
options.dir: If toward, it tilts toward the cursor (default is away)
